Printing Model Information

Source: R/print.bvarmodel.R
print.bvarmodel.Rd

print method for objects of class 'bvarmodel'.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bvarmodel'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class 'bvarmodel'.

digits

the number of significant digits to use when printing.

...

further arguments passed to or from other methods.

Value

A data frame of the model's specification, as printed, invisibly. It is the result of get_model_specifications with the columns renamed for display and, where the model has no unmodelled variables, the columns m and s dropped.
